definitions.explanation: A plan or expectation about how things will turn out, often with an undertone of strategic thinking or personal calculation. Can be neutral or carry a slightly negative nuance of scheming.

examples.japanese: {目論見|もくろみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{外|はず}れた→外れる：02395_hazureru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{目論見|もくろみ}{通|どお}り、⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}した→成功する：21445_seikousuru⟧。
examples.english: Just as he had planned, the business succeeded.

examples.japanese: ⟦{安|やす}く→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦{仕入|しい}れて→仕入れる：11430_shiireru⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{売|う}る→売る：00906_uru⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧{目論見|もくろみ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{見事|みごと}→見事：03744_migoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The scheme of buying cheap and selling high failed spectacularly.

notes:
USAGE:
Often implies a calculated expectation or strategic plan. When the plan fails, the common expression is {目論見|もくろみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{外|はず}れる→外れる：02395_hazureru⟧. When it succeeds: {目論見|もくろみ}{通|どお}り. Can carry a slightly scheming or self-interested nuance depending on context.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {目論見|もくろみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{外|はず}れる→外れる：02395_hazureru⟧ (one's plan backfires)
- {目論見|もくろみ}{通|どお}り (as planned/calculated)
- {目論見|もくろみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧ (one's plan hits the mark)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧: plan — neutral, formal, without the strategic or self-interested nuance
- ⟦{企|たくら}み→企み：20805_takurami⟧: scheme, plot — stronger negative nuance, implies deceit
- {算段|さんだん}: strategy, plan — similar to {目論見|もくろみ} but more colloquial
